title: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
claim: MCP is an integration protocol for AI applications to connect to external data sources and tools; it is not itself a financial dataset.
evidence: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems.
verification: Extracted from the official MCP documentation; retrieved 2026-10-26.

title: MCP Server | OpenBB Docs
claim: OpenBB's MCP server exposes installed OpenBB REST API routes as tools; install the MCP server package plus selected providers.
evidence: `openbb-mcp` turns the routes of the OpenBB REST API into MCP tools. Each installed provider contributes its commands, so the tool list is whatever the environment has installed.
verification: Read the V5 OpenBB official quickstart, install examples, and transport configuration; retrieved 2026-10-26.

title: Providers | OpenBB Docs
claim: OpenBB is a connector layer, not a host of financial data; the ECB provider is listed without credentials, while source terms and rate limits remain upstream-specific.
evidence: OpenBB does not host or serve data. Provider packages are connectors to public or third-party services, and coverage, rate limits, and terms of use are set by those services.
verification: Read the official provider matrix; it lists `openbb-ecb` with no credentials and explicitly assigns data coverage/terms to providers. Retrieved 2026-10-26.

title: License | OpenBB Docs
claim: OpenBB V5 software is Apache-2.0, but its software license does not grant redistribution rights to provider data.
evidence: The license covers the software. Provider packages connect to public or third-party services, and the data they return is subject to each source's own terms of use, which may restrict storage, redistribution, or commercial use.
verification: Read the official V5 license FAQ, including its separate answer on provider data; retrieved 2026-10-26.
